DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput * hwaMemOutDoppler
 HWA scratch memory for producing intermediate cfar detection list in Doppler domain, cannot be overlaid with other HWA scratch memory inputs specified in this structure. Must be different memory bank than bank(s) of hwaMemInpSize. Must be aligned to DPU_CFARPROCHWA_HWA_MEM_OUT_DOPPLER_BYTE_ALIGNMENT. Note this need not be the start of a HWA memory bank but typically it is, and is therefore naturally aligned to this alignment requirement.
 
uint32_t hwaMemOutDopplerSize
 Number of elements of type DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput of HWA memory for cfar detection list in Doppler domain.
 
DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput * hwaMemOutRange
 HWA scratch memory for producing intermediate cfar detection list in Range domain, cannot be overlaid with other HWA scratch memory inputs for this DPU. Must be different memory bank than bank(s) of hwaMemInp. Must be aligned to DPU_CFARPROCHWA_HWA_MEM_OUT_RANGE_BYTE_ALIGNMENT. Note this need not be the start of a HWA memory bank but typically it is, and is therefore naturally aligned to this alignment requirement.
 
uint32_t hwaMemOutRangeSize
 Number of elements of type DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput of HWA memory for cfar detection list in Range domain.
 
uint32_t * cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask
 Scratch memory for Doppler cfar detection bit mask. Must be aligned to DPU_CFARPROCHWA_DOPPLER_DET_OUT_BIT_MASK_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_R5F or DPU_CFARPROCHWA_DOPPLER_DET_OUT_BIT_MASK_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_DSP depending on the core.
 
uint32_t cfarDopplerDetOutBitMaskSize
 Number of elements of type uint32_t of scratch memory for bit mask of Doppler cfar detections. Must be >= (numRangeBins * numDoppplerBins) / 32.
